title: The Event Tickets with Ticket Scanner plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'code' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.1 due…
desc: The Event Tickets with Ticket Scanner plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'code' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload persists through WooCommerce session data into order-item metadata and executes when rendered in the ticket scanner interface.

title: An authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed authenticated users to read review-thread data from…
desc: An authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed authenticated users to read review-thread data from private repositories they could not access. An attacker required an authenticated account, a readable repository and pull request to use as the request context, and target review-thread identifiers. The thread-preview endpoint resolved supplied identifiers without restricting them to the authorized pull request, exposing private file paths and, when positioning and diff data were available, source-code excerpts, commit identifiers, and line metadata without victim interaction. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases in the 3.21, 3.22 series and was fixed in versions 3.21.10, 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

title: Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability.
desc: Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. Exploitation could lead to arbitrary command execution with root privileges on the appliance.

title: The SchemaEngine AI – AI Schema Markup, Reviews & Rich Snippets for SEO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content/excerpt (REST…
desc: The SchemaEngine AI – AI Schema Markup, Reviews & Rich Snippets for SEO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content/excerpt (REST wp/v2/posts) → stored in post_content/post_excerpt' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. A Contributor's entity-encoded payload survives save-time wp_kses filtering verbatim and is only decoded into raw script tags at render time via html_entity_decode(), meaning the injected script executes for every visitor — including authenticated Administrators — once an Editor publishes the post through the standard Contributor workflow.

title: Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server HTTP transport.
desc:
Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server HTTP transport. A self-issued JSON Web Token (JWT) identified the user only by numeric user ID, and a new user takes the lowest free ID. After an administrator deleted a user, that user's unexpired token, or a token refreshed from it while the ID was free, authenticated as the next account created with that ID and had that account's permissions. Only deployments with HTTP enabled are affected.

This issue affects Apache Iggy: through 0.9.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue.

title: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1 through 2.1.2, a listener configured with `protocol websockets` mishandles empty WebSocket data frames.
desc: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1 through 2.1.2, a listener configured with `protocol websockets` mishandles empty WebSocket data frames. `net__read_ws()` in `lib/net_ws.c` returns the number of framing bytes consumed (the 4 masking-key bytes) for a data frame with a zero-length payload, without writing any bytes to the caller’s buffer. The MQTT packet reader in `packet__read_single()` (`lib/packet_mosq.c`) trusts that return value as a payload byte count. A remote client can therefore advance the read position over an uninitialised heap allocation, causing the broker to process and forward uninitialised heap memory (information disclosure, including heap and libc pointers), and can underflow the unsigned `to_process` counter so that subsequent attacker-controlled frame data is written past the end of the allocation (heap out-of-bounds write). The out-of-bounds write is reachable from the CONNECT packet before any authentication check, so an unauthenticated client can corrupt the heap and crash the broker even when `allow_anonymous false` is set. Combining the disclosure and the write allows remote code execution as the broker’s user by any client able to establish a session.

title: An incorrect authorization vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated user whose numeric user ID matched an enterprise's numeric ID to…
desc: An incorrect authorization vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated user whose numeric user ID matched an enterprise's numeric ID to manage that enterprise's GitHub Apps and generate private keys without enterprise membership. GitHub App ownership checks compared numeric IDs without checking the owner's account type. Exploitation required control of a session for the colliding user account and an enterprise-owned GitHub App. A generated private key could be used to authenticate as the App and access repositories where it was installed, within its granted permissions. On standard fresh installations, the documented collision involved the non-loginable built-in ghost account; the reported GHES reproduction used site administrator impersonation. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

title: CAST Imaging has an access control flaw in the "/api/jobs/<uuid>/logs/download" endpoint.
desc:
CAST Imaging has an access control flaw in the "/api/jobs/<uuid>/logs/download" endpoint. An authenticated low-privilege user can download log archives for any job whose UUID they know, even if they are not authorized to access it.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

title: CAST Imaging allows authenticated, low-privileged users to access parts of the administrator panel.
desc:
CAST Imaging allows authenticated, low-privileged users to access parts of the administrator panel. When a user navigates to any URL path the application doesn't recognize, a wildcard route automatically redirects them to the administrative view at "/admin/applications". This allows an attacker to perform certain administrator-restricted actions, including triggering app-to-app link generation, configuring regexes, and changing searchable object properties, resulting in unauthorized modification of application configuration.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

title: CAST Imaging does not properly check whether a user is authorized to modify another user's notification settings in the "/api/admin/user/update-subscriber" endpoint.
desc:
CAST Imaging does not properly check whether a user is authorized to modify another user's notification settings in the "/api/admin/user/update-subscriber" endpoint. An authenticated, low-privileged attacker can enable or disable email notifications on another user's behalf, which can suppress important communications such as security alerts and disrupt business processes.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

title: CAST Imaging contains a hardcoded authentication token in the "KeyCloakController" class of auth-service.jar.
desc:
CAST Imaging contains a hardcoded authentication token in the "KeyCloakController" class of auth-service.jar. An attacker who gains access to the source code, application package, logs, or configuration files can reuse this token to call auth-service endpoints without authentication. Using the token with the "/api/auth/keycloak/users" endpoint, the attacker can enumerate users across Keycloak realms and retrieve user attributes containing API token hashes, enabling reconnaissance and further exploitation.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

title: CAST Imaging is vulnerable to Path Traversal vulnerability in "/api/server-folders" and "/api/server-folders/download" endpoints.
desc:
CAST Imaging is vulnerable to Path Traversal vulnerability in "/api/server-folders" and "/api/server-folders/download" endpoints. These file-management endpoints accept user-supplied filesystem paths and allow selected system commands to be executed at the specified location, but they do not enforce sufficient authorization boundaries or restrict access to a predefined set of resources. An authenticated attacker can enumerate server directories via the "ls" command and retrieve arbitrary files outside of the intended application workspace, such as "/etc/passwd", exposing sensitive data.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

title: CAST Imaging has a missing authentication vulnerability in the "/api/auth/keycloak/users/{username}" endpoint.
desc:
CAST Imaging has a missing authentication vulnerability in the "/api/auth/keycloak/users/{username}" endpoint. An unauthenticated remote attacker can modify the email address of an arbitrary Keycloak user and access sensitive account information, including the API authentication token hash. This can lead to account takeover, user impersonation and user enumeration.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

title: CAST Imaging has multiple path traversal vulnerabilities in various endpoints.
desc:
CAST Imaging has multiple path traversal vulnerabilities in various endpoints. The application does not properly validate the path parameters, allowing an authenticated attacker to use "../" sequences to escape the intended directory and read arbitrary files.


Critically, by reading "/proc/self/environ", the attacker can obtain environment variables containing sensitive credentials such as Keycloak and PostgreSQL passwords, leading to full server compromise and administrative access.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

title: CAST Imaging is vulnerable to authentication bypass in the TenantFilter class.
desc:
CAST Imaging is vulnerable to authentication bypass in the TenantFilter class. The TenantFilter processes the X-ISSUER-LOCATION HTTP header and dynamically registers an OpenID Connect issuer based on its value. An unauthenticated remote attacker can register a malicious identity provider, create users matching existing administrative usernames, and obtain valid JWTs which will be accepted by the application. This results in complete authentication bypass and privilege escalation to administrative access.




The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

title: The WP Maps – Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, Mapbox, Store Locator with Search, Filters & Listings plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'csv_columns'…
desc: The WP Maps – Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, Mapbox, Store Locator with Search, Filters & Listings plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'csv_columns' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.2 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

desc: An XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability affects a Storefront REST API in HCL Commerce versions 8, 9.0.1 and 9.1.x.  A remote attacker, using a specially crafted XML, could potentially view internal files or consume memory resources.

title: The Royal Addons for Elementor WordPress plugin before 1.7.1071 does not restrict or validate the post meta keys used when counting or rendering a filtered grid, and does not…
desc: The Royal Addons for Elementor  WordPress plugin before 1.7.1071 does not restrict or validate the post meta keys used when counting or rendering a filtered grid, and does not reject private (hidden) meta keys, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the value of arbitrary private post meta one value at a time from the filtered result count. title: A flaw was found in CRI-O.
desc: A flaw was found in CRI-O. When the optional Linux LinkLogs feature is enabled, the host pod log directory is bind-mounted into a pod emptyDir and is intended to be read-only, but Linux ignores MS_RDONLY on the initial bind and the CRI mount stays writable. A non-privileged UID 0 container can place a symlink at a future kubelet log path so that privileged conmon later appends attacker-controlled log data to an existing host file. This is an append-only host integrity issue, not universal remote code execution; LinkLogs is not enabled by default.

title: A path traversal vulnerability (CWE-22) was found in ansible-core's ansible-galaxy role installation.
desc: A path traversal vulnerability (CWE-22) was found in ansible-core's ansible-galaxy role installation. An explicit role "name" taken from a role's meta/requirements.yml is used to construct the on-disk installation path without validating that the resulting destination stays within the selected roles directory. A name containing "../" escapes that directory, and an absolute name replaces it entirely. Because ansible-galaxy processes transitive dependencies from an installed role's meta/requirements.yml, a malicious role publisher can cause attacker-supplied files to be written outside the operator's chosen roles directory when the operator installs the role, and, when --force is used, can cause an existing role directory outside that path to be removed and replaced. The impact is bounded by the invoking user's filesystem permissions and requires the operator to install the attacker-influenced content.

title: The Delivery & Pickup Date Time for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in versions up to, and including, 1.3.90.
desc: The Delivery & Pickup Date Time for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in versions up to, and including, 1.3.90. This is due to a nonce-only settings AJAX handler that stores an attribute-breaking value and an administrator settings template that outputs it without HTML attribute escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

title: The Envira Gallery WordPress plugin before 1.16.4 does not apply its own gallery-permission policy until an administrator first opens its permissions screen, instead copying…
desc: The Envira Gallery  WordPress plugin before 1.16.4 does not apply its own gallery-permission policy until an administrator first opens its permissions screen, instead copying gallery-management capabilities onto each role from that role's core post capabilities after activation, which lets Contributor accounts create, edit and delete galleries that the policy is meant to restrict to higher roles.

title: The Asset CleanUp: Page Speed Booster plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.0.6…
desc: The Asset CleanUp: Page Speed Booster plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.0.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit succeeds even though wp_kses is applied on save, because the XSS is manufactured post-sanitization by the plugin's regex pass: kses-permitted tags such as <a title> and <code> carry the attacker's marker and terminator strings intact into the rendered HTML buffer, where the plugin's own replacement then corrupts the document structure.
